text:
Aisha: @channel quick sync — Frontier Early Lab enrollment opens tomorrow 10am PST. Need a final checklist for enablement docs, SSO invites, and the short feedback micro-survey. :wave:
Liam: Got it. I can queue SSO invites and seats. Who's approving the seat list?
Aisha: @Riley we have 12 seats approved — can you confirm the invite template?
Riley: Editing now. I'll add setup steps + short call checklist. Will post draft here in 15.
Carlos: Heads-up: one customer (NovaFin) flagged concern about model latency baseline — want to add a baseline dashboard before launch. :warning:
Aisha: Good catch. We should push baseline dashboard to the onboarding folder and attach to the invite email. @Carlos can you own it?
Carlos: Yup. I'll assemble a lightweight dashboard (p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost estimate). ETA EOD today.
PreviewBot: [auto] Enrollment form submitted: https://redwood.test/forms/earlylab — 8 responses so far.
Liam: I created the invite group `early-lab-access` and set role preview-beta. Use `/invite early-lab-access @user` to bulk add.
Riley: Draft invite: "Welcome to Frontier Early Lab — 30-min kickoff + enablement doc + short NPS after week 1." Posting snippet:
```
Kickoff: 30m
Enablement: https://redwood.docs/earlylab-setup
Survey: 4 Qs via Typeform
```
Aisha: Love it. Two asks: (1) add renewal-risk flag in Gainsight for customers who don't open the survey within 14 days; (2) schedule a 2-week check-in for low-usage accounts.
Liam: I'll add the Gainsight tag `earlylab:survey-missed` and automation to ping CSMs after 14 days.
Riley: I'll create a Loom for the onboarding steps and attach to invites.
Carlos: One technical note — if the customer is on dedicated infra, tell them to whitelist IPs: `34.82.12.9/32` and `34.82.12.10/32`.
Aisha: Fantastic. Final checklist:
- Draft invite (Riley)
- Dashboard baseline (Carlos)
- SSO invites (Liam)
- Loom + docs (Riley)
- Gainsight automation (Liam)
- Survey + Typeform (Aisha)
I'll run a 9:30am pre-launch smoke test. :thumbsup:
Liam: I'll be on the smoke test. :thumbsup:
Riley: Done — posted loom link and invite template in #docs. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: Great ship. If anything blocks, drop here. Otherwise I'll post kickoff notes after launch.
